title: About Jerry
content: Jerry is a Cloud & DevOps Engineer and IT infrastructure professional with 20+ years of hands-on experience across networking, systems administration, cloud engineering, security, DevOps and technical support. His career grew from network and systems administration into cloud engineering, DevOps and infrastructure automation.

title: Core skills
content: Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD. Networks & Systems: Linux, TCP/IP, VPN, MikroTik, systems administration. Security & Reliability: network security, cloud security, RBAC, IT compliance. Automation & Code: Python, Bash, JavaScript, Node.js, API integration. AI & LLMs: generative AI, local LLM deployment (Ollama, LiteLLM), AI agents, AI-assisted engineering. Observability & Tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, SonarQube, Portainer.

title: Project: Local LLM & AI Automation Lab
content: An ongoing project experimenting with Ollama, open-source models, LiteLLM and n8n to build practical local AI and agentic workflows, including a Telegram-triggered research agent.

title: Project: Cloud & Kubernetes Labs
content: Hands-on infrastructure environments covering containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Project: Igbo Voice AI
content: An exploratory project converting English text to spoken Igbo using local language models and text-to-speech technology, aimed at closing the gap in AI tooling for under-served African languages.

title: Education
content: MSc Information Technology, National Open University of Nigeria (2013-2017). Certifications: Google IT Support (2023-2024), Cloud Security (2024), ALX Professional Foundation (2024).

title: Availability and contact
content: Jerry is based in Nigeria and available for remote work. He's open to remote Cloud, DevOps, infrastructure, technical support and AI-focused opportunities. The best way to reach him is by email (see the Contact section on the site) or LinkedIn.

title: Career history
content: 20+ years in IT infrastructure and technical administration across Linux/Windows environments, directory services and RBAC. Contributed to campus-wide broadband connectivity projects across six tertiary institutions. Coordinated technology delivery projects with stakeholders and requirements. Worked remotely as an application tester.
